paprika12 rashers of streaky bacon, halved150g sour cream1 small bunch chives1/2 tsp garlic powder1 lemonHalve the jalapenos lengthways and scrape out the seeds.Beat the cream cheese with cheddar and paprika and pack into the halves.Wrap each in half a rasher of bacon and pin with a toothpick.Bake on a rack at 200°C until the bacon is crisp.Mix the sour cream with chives, garlic powder and lemon white vinegar250ml water1 tbsp salt200g sharp vintage cheddarPack the cucumbers into a jar with garlic, dill and peppercorns.Boil the vinegar with the water and salt and pour over.Pickle for a week in minutes, turning once, until crisp.Melt 60g butter with 100ml hot sauce.Mash 100g blue cheese into 150g sour cream with a squeeze of lemon.Toss the hot wings in the sauce and serve with the dip and
